newsitem.title: USA: Mobil unit to partner with Pequiven.
newsitem.headline: Mobil unit to partner with Pequiven.

text.p: - Mobil Chemical Co, a division of Mobil Oil Corp, said on Monday that it has been selected as a partner by Pequiven, the petrochemical affiliate of Venezuela's state-owned oil company, Petroleos de Venezuela, S.A. PDVSA, to develop an olefins complex in Venezuela.
The proposed facility, to cost about $1.5 billion, would be located at an existing petrochemicals site at Jose in the Venezuela state of Anzoatequi, the Mobil unit said.

A 50-50 joint venture company would be formed to operate the proposed facility and market its products, the company said, and construction of the complex is expected to begin in 1998 with start-up scheduled for 2000.
"This project supports our strategy to build our olefins business through ownership in the best manufacturing facilities in the world," said Mobil Chemical Co President Raymond McGowan.

The proposed Jose complex will have ready access to growing Latin America markets and will complement Mobil's Beaumont, Texas., production by making available additional volumes and different grades of polyethylene to further strengthen both Mobil's and Pequiven's polyethylene businesses in the Western Hemisphere, the Mobile unit said.
The project is expected to create about 4,600 construction jobs at its peak and about 600 new permanent operations jobs in the Jose area.
